breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = πd⁴/32 in both torsion formulas (τ_max = Tc/J and φ = TL/(JG)), never substituting the bending second moment I for the polar moment J. Although the spec unnecessarily mentions computing I = πd⁴/64, it does not apply I in any torsion relation, so the core inconsistency—using I instead of J in torsion—is fully corrected, matching the ground truth's intent.
